title: Playboy November 1988 Jessica Rabbit Cover Bruce Willis Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers bright with no tears; spine intact. A light crease across the barcode at the top right corner of the front cover (see photo 2) and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, November 1988 issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Famous illustrated Jessica Rabbit cover (Who Framed Roger Rabbit), from the annual cinema issue. Also: Playboy Interview with Bruce Willis; election coverage Playboy style, the Women of Washington; Bush & Dukakis by Robert Scheer; Why Everyone Is Acting So Weird.

Back cover: Panasonic cordless phone ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
